_comment: Curated bout index for the women_65 batch 2 sourcing pass (women_65_batch2.json),
2026-08-27. Same field shape as trials_2023_24_bouts.json (start/end/label/event/
division/note, `label` = 'Winner vs. Opponent' with the WINNER FORCED FIRST per
scripts/gemini_normalize.py's rule -- it splits `curated['label']` on ' vs. ' and takes
the first name as the published winner, overwriting whatever a model claims).
One deliberate format extension: trials_2023_24_bouts.json indexes a SINGLE compilation
video, so it carries one top-level `url` and every bout is just a start/end window into
it. This batch's bouts live on four different videos (and several more not yet on any
video), so each bout below carries its own `url` (null when unresolved) instead of one
shared top-level url. `method` is an added field the sourcing task asked for explicitly
-- trials_2023_24_bouts.json folds method into free-text `note` instead.
`ts_status`: 'resolved' has a real start/end; 'pending_ts' means the video is sourced
(see women_65_batch2.json) but nobody has located the bout's video-absolute seconds yet;
'pending_url' means no video has been resolved for this bout at all -- both leave
start/end null rather than guessing, same rule women_65.json's Entry.start/end docstring
gives for a highlight reel with no located bouts.
`rrb_priority`: true marks a bout the sourcing task starred as unlocking rrb.
Two bouts carry existing-data flags instead of being blind new targets:
- ana-vieira-vs-gabrielle-mccomb: already rendered + curated via the trials_2023_24
pipeline (see women_65_batch2.json's cross-reference note). `already_sourced`.
- helena-crevar-vs-aislinn-oconnell: already in prod with 0 sequence events
(scripts/dumps/adcc_trials2023_ec_semis_data.py). `already_in_db` + `re_read` --
this is an enrichment target, not a new match row.
helena-crevar-vs-aurelie-le-vern was checked against the already-ingested -65kg supercut
dump (scripts/dumps/supercut_the_entire_2024_adcc_worlds_65kg_bracket_data.py): that dump
covers Opening Round / Semifinal / Bronze / Final only, no Quarterfinal round and no
Aurelie Le Vern anywhere (verified by grep). This bout is genuinely missing, not a
duplicate of ingested footage.
amanda-leve-x4 is left as ONE aggregate placeholder row, not four invented bouts:
the sourcing task named no opponents and no confirmed methods for those four fights.
